analysis.primary: Original question: pre-answer minus initial verified-versus-pattern log odds; average the two matched variants within each independent world, complete worlds only.
analysis.secondary: Same prespecified analysis for explicit lookup; both frozen cues retained, cue 0 primary and cue 1 sensitivity.
analysis.bootstrap: Unchanged v5 clustered(): seed 981723, 10000 resamples, 95% interval.
analysis.missing: Never zero-impute readouts or treat unavailable answers as incorrect; report coverage, complete-pair denominators and unknowns.
analysis.descriptive: Checkpoint levels, paired changes from initial, complete-checkpoint cohorts, verified-to-pattern reversals and recovery, cue agreement, and actual answer correctness.
analysis.selection: All 56 remaining worlds retained regardless of outcome; no stopping, replacement, threshold tuning or event selection.
analysis.provenance: Amendment decided after examining four pilot worlds. Report those separately, never as untouched validation. No pooled claim required.
analysis.scope: Fixed/pre-answer Study 2A only; no semantic-event annotations, evidence probes or Study 2B interventions.

rationale: Complete the prespecified fixed sample and conditional answer-preference replication independently of unresolved semantic review and Study 2B. The four-world pilot was examined before this workflow decision.
